_instructions: A repository ADMIN captures the protected environment from the GitHub API (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/production-release) and commits the result as release-policy/environment-capture.json through a reviewed PR. The authority-admission job feeds it to the predicate as `actual.environment`; a capture whose fields are not all true is DENIED (ENVIRONMENT_ABSENT / ENVIRONMENT_UNPROTECTED / ENVIRONMENT_TAG_POLICY_MISMATCH). No script writes the real file. Re-capture after ANY change to the environment.
name: production-release
